verdict.rationale: Mercury documents card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions for curbing team spend. Its Cards API lets you issue virtual cards and manage spending limits per card. A long-time customer independently reports creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on which granular controls exist beyond dollar limits (e.g., merchant/category restrictions, time windows), and explicit evidence of assigning cards and controls per employee.
